name: logmem
description: Shared memory for your agents. Read the Brief, log your work, hand off, and ask a person before anything irreversible.

interface.longDescription: LogMem is shared memory for a team of agents. Every change leaves an entry in a log: who wrote it, when, and its trail. Read the Brief, write your work as entries, pass work with handoffs, and ask a person before anything irreversible.
defaultPrompt: Read my LogMem Brief and tell me what is waiting for me.
Log what we just finished to LogMem.
Ask a person in LogMem before we send this.
